verdict.rationale: Formant gets sensor data into its platform rather than providing hardware drivers. The evidence shows a ROS 2 Docker agent install path, an Agent SDK for ingesting telemetry, and claims of connecting multiple robot types with uniform, searchable data and time-synced video and sensor records. That suggests sensor streams can be brought in through ROS 2 and the SDK, but nothing names specific camera, lidar, IMU or GPS drivers or standard message types. Missing for 10: ready-made drivers for cameras, lidars, IMUs and GPS; documentation of supported standard message types; hands-on or independent evidence of sensor bring-up.
